note: Large Alberta Parks campground 12 km west of Bragg Creek off Hwy 66, 1.3 km south on McLean Creek Trail, in a foothills forest. Loops C and D (sites 71-170) are built for campers with off-highway vehicles, with trails to the staging area of the McLean Creek Public Land Use Zone; loops A and B are not. Tap water runs only from mid-May to Thanksgiving, and the dump is a dry dump. There is a playground, an amphitheatre and a campground store (May 1 to Thanksgiving). --Claude
